vergō

vergō, vergere

verb, third conjugation, with ad or in + acc.

of a place: lie towards, face, slope towards; slope, lie towards

In this lexicon

  • face

    the recommended word · classical · Caes. B.G. 1.1: Galliae pars ad septentriōnēs (Lewis & Short); Liv. 37.31.10: portus in merīdiem (Lewis & Short); Traupman 339

  • slope down

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 206; Traupman 204: to lie in the direction of, vergere ad

Examples

  • Prānsī in hortum botanicum intrāvērunt, quī ab aquaeductū ad flūmen vergit

    After lunch they went into the botanical garden, which slopes from the aqueduct down to the riverLibellus III, Apud avum et aviam
